notes.md: - **Tribal dictionaries:** In **November 2018**, **Odisha** released **bilingual dictionaries of 21 tribal languages** (with Odia), made by its Academy of Tribal Language and Culture and SCSTRTI, for multilingual education in tribal areas.

new.s: Which office releases the Civil Registration System (CRS) report on births and deaths in India?
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
new.x: The CRS report (CRS 2024, released 1 July 2026) is issued by the Registrar General of India (RGI).
new.angle: U0649 notes gap: CRS -> publisher RGI

new.s: Which State recorded the lowest sex ratio at birth in the CRS 2024 data?
new.x: In CRS 2024, Nagaland (865) had the lowest sex ratio at birth among States; Jharkhand had 890.
new.angle: U0649 notes gap: CRS 2024 lowest SRB State

new.s: What was India's sex ratio in Census 1901?
new.x: India's sex ratio was 972 in 1901; it then fell to 964 in 1911 and to an all-time low of 927 in 1991.
new.angle: U0649 notes gap: 1901 sex ratio

new.s: Which institution prepared the Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) Index for the EAC-PM?
new.x: The FLN Index was prepared by the Institute for Competitiveness for the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister.
new.angle: U0650 notes gap: FLN Index -> preparer

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Foundational Literacy and Numeracy Index:
1. It was prepared by the Institute for Competitiveness for the EAC-PM.
2. Punjab had the highest score in its second edition.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Institute for Competitiveness prepared the index for the EAC-PM, and Punjab topped its second edition.
new.angle: U0650 notes gap: FLN Index -> preparer (statements)

new.s: By which year does NEP 2020 aim to achieve 100 per cent Gross Enrolment Ratio in school education?
new.x: NEP 2020 targets 100% school GER by 2030; the 50% higher-education GER target is for 2035.
new.angle: U0650 notes gap: NEP school GER target

new.s: What was India's Gross Enrolment Ratio in higher education as per AISHE 2023-24?
new.x: AISHE 2023-24 (released 8 July 2026) put the higher-education GER at about 30.
new.angle: U0650 notes gap: AISHE GER

new.s: What was the Gender Parity Index in higher education as per AISHE 2023-24?
new.x: AISHE 2023-24 reported a GPI of 1.08, as female GER (31.2) is above male GER.
new.angle: U0650 notes gap: AISHE GPI

new.s: Which organisation declared 8 September as International Literacy Day?
new.x: UNESCO declared International Literacy Day in 1966; it was first observed in 1967.
new.angle: U0650 notes gap: International Literacy Day -> UNESCO

new.s: What was the main mass-campaign strategy of the National Literacy Mission launched in 1988?
new.x: The Total Literacy Campaign (1989-90) was the main mass-campaign strategy of the National Literacy Mission.
new.angle: U0650 notes gap: NLM -> TLC

new.s: In which year was the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) launched?
new.x: PMEGP was launched in 2008 by merging PMRY and REGP; KVIC is its nodal agency.
new.angle: U0651 notes gap: PMEGP year

new.s: About what was India's female labour force participation rate (aged 15 and above) in 2025?
new.angle: U0651 notes gap: female LFPR 2025

new.s: In which year were Sikhs made eligible for Scheduled Caste status?
new.x: SC status was first for Hindus only; Sikhs were added in 1956 and Buddhists in 1990.
new.angle: U0652 notes gap: Sikhs SC status 1956

new.s: How many Scheduled Caste groups are notified across 31 States/UTs of India?
new.x: Scheduled Castes are notified in 31 States/UTs, covering 1,241 groups; 705 is the number of notified STs.
new.angle: U0652 notes gap: number of SC groups

new.s: Bharmour in Chamba district of Himachal Pradesh is the homeland of which tribe?
new.x: The Gaddis, transhumant shepherds of the Dhauladhar, live in Bharmour (Chamba) and Kangra in Himachal Pradesh.
new.angle: U0653 notes gap: Bharmour -> Gaddi

new.s: Which tribe is known for making bamboo baskets?
new.x: The Kamar make bamboo baskets; the Agaria are iron-makers and the Khairwar make catechu.
new.angle: U0653 notes gap: livelihood -> Kamar

new.s: By which Constitutional Amendment were Konkani, Manipuri and Nepali added to the Eighth Schedule?
new.x: The 71st Amendment (1992) added Konkani, Manipuri and Nepali; the 92nd (2003) added Santali.
new.angle: U0653 notes gap: 71st Amendment languages

new.s: How many PVTGs do Andhra Pradesh and Telangana together have?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh including Telangana has 12 PVTGs, second to Odisha (13).
new.angle: U0653 notes gap: AP+Telangana PVTG count

new.s: In which Act is the term 'Critical Wildlife Habitat' defined?
new.x: 'Critical Wildlife Habitat' is defined in the Forest Rights Act, 2006.
new.angle: U0653 notes gap: Critical Wildlife Habitat -> FRA 2006

new.s: How many interventions does PM-JANMAN cover for PVTGs?
new.x: PM-JANMAN (15 November 2023) covers 75 PVTGs through 11 interventions from 2023-24 to 2025-26.
new.angle: U0653 notes gap: PM-JANMAN interventions

new.s: In which State do the Dafla and Mishmi tribes mainly live?
new.x: The Dafla and Mishmi are tribes of Arunachal Pradesh.
new.angle: U0653 notes gap: Dafla, Mishmi -> Arunachal

new.s: Which State released bilingual dictionaries of 21 tribal languages in 2018?
new.x: In November 2018 Odisha released bilingual dictionaries of its 21 tribal languages for multilingual education.
new.angle: U0653 web: #14 tribal language preservation -> state tribal dictionaries

new.s: How many tribal languages are covered by the bilingual tribal dictionaries released by Odisha in 2018?
new.x: Odisha's 2018 bilingual dictionaries cover 21 tribal languages; 62 is the number of notified tribes of Odisha.
new.angle: U0653 web: #14 state tribal dictionaries -> count

new.s: What was India's level of urbanisation in Census 2001?
new.x: India's urban share rose from 27.8% in 2001 to 31.16% in 2011.
new.angle: U0654 notes gap: urbanisation 2001

new.s: Which organisation estimated in 2010 that 55.3 per cent of India's population lived in 'urban-like' areas?
new.x: The World Bank (2010) put India's 'urban-like' share at 55.3%, against 31% in the Census.
new.angle: U0654 notes gap: World Bank urban-like estimate

new.s: Under the 16th Finance Commission, the share of urban local bodies in local body grants rises from 36 per cent to what level?
new.x: The 16th Finance Commission raises the urban bodies' share of local grants from 36% to 45%; 41% is its projected urbanisation for 2031.
new.angle: U0654 notes gap: 16th FC urban grants share

new.s: How much does the Union Budget 2026-27 provide for each City Economic Region over five years?
new.x: Budget 2026-27 provides Rs 5,000 crore per City Economic Region over five years.
new.angle: U0654 notes gap: City Economic Region allocation
